environment.description: Production ECS Fargate deployment with 3 task replicas behind an ALB. The feature flag SDK (Split.io) is configured with the 'loyalty-migration-2024q1' flag set to ON for the 'ops-internal' segment. The /admin/force-migration endpoint is reachable. No distributed locking mechanism (Redis/DynamoDB lock) is in place. Each replica has its own SQLite database mounted from a shared EFS volume, meaning concurrent writes from multiple tasks can interleave. The ALB distributes requests round-robin across all 3 tasks.
